margined.summary: Balbases at Nijmegen to Fuenmayor in Copenhagen, read at the time: the contemporary margin decipherment is transcribed in tx/ and set beside the key output in read/.
margined.en:
I am glad of the good hope that Monsieur d'Amerongen had given about his masters' disposition towards obtaining the
guarantee sought for the town of Bremen; for unless there is some hidden reason that I cannot see, I always consider
the settlement of that assembly advisable, in the form that Your Lordship sent me as a proposal.

unread.summary: Balbases at Nijmegen to Fuenmayor in Copenhagen, not deciphered before (gist from NOTES): On the protest the Imperial ministers published about the dissolution of the Bremen assembly. He has nothing to add: "de nuestra parte no nos queda que hacer sino es … temer" what the confederates will do.
